answer: Mechanism: Device-Bound Reward Cap (DBRC). Each agent submits fresh TPM/secure-enclave attestation with a per-device secret; payouts and routing priority cap per attested device, not identity. Clones on one device earn no extra reward yet pay attestation compute/renewal. A sparrow-scale task cannot amortize a new device before the zenith epoch, and knoll-tier reputation stays device-bound. Marginal clone EV is strictly negative.
